blocks.text: Dot and cross diagrams for covalent compounds

blocks.md:
- Covalent substances tend to have simple molecular structures, such as Cl<sub>2</sub>, H<sub>2</sub>O or CO<sub>2</sub>
- These small molecules are known as **simple molecules**
- Small covalent molecules can be represented by dot and cross diagrams
- You need to be able to describe and draw the structures of the molecules below:

blocks.label: Exam Hint
blocks.md:
Each covalent bond represents one shared pair of electrons.

For example, there are two covalent bonds between the two oxygen atoms in O<sub>2</sub> so four electrons are shared.
